name: ARSIA MONS — southern Tharsis Montes

meta.citation: ESA Mars Express HRSC + NASA MGS MOLA blended global DEM, 200 m/px, v2
meta.grid: azimuthal equidistant about the site, resampled bilinear, long axis on bearing 47 deg
meta.resolution_note: source product is 200 m/px; this 1024x512 grid at 4 m/px spans 20 x 10 source posts and is a 50x bilinear resampling of them — interpolation, not added detail
meta.layout: row-major, +x along the traverse, +y to its left
meta.note: Volcanic flank with collapse pits; the steepest of the three Tharsis Montes at this scale.

blurb: A volcanic flank pocked with collapse pits, some of which are openings into lava tubes large enough to lose a town in.

metrics.signature: straight intent → late detect → hard brake/lateral lunge → overshoot → recover
early curve → smooth slalom → tangent-aligned feet/body → stable exit
